import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyWeilDivisor

/-! # Invariance of stalk length under open restriction -/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Open restriction preserves the intrinsic module length at each stalk. -/
theorem stalkLength_restrict (F : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) (x : U) :
    stalkLength (F.restrict U.ι) x = stalkLength F x.val := by
  let P := F.restrict U.ι
  let StP := (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk P.val.presheaf x) : Type u)
  let StF := (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x.val) : Type u)
  letI : Module ((U : Scheme).presheaf.stalk x) StP := presheafStalkModule P.val x
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x.val) StF := presheafStalkModule F.val x.val
  let e : StP ≃+ StF := ((restrictStalkNatIso U.ι x).app F).addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv
  let l : StP →ₛₗ[(U.stalkIso x).hom.hom] StF :=
    { e.toAddMonoidHom with
      map_smul' := fun r m => by
        obtain ⟨W, hxW, a, ha⟩ := (U : Scheme).presheaf.exists_germ_eq r
        obtain ⟨V, hVW, hxV, s, hs⟩ :=
          TopCat.Presheaf.exists_le_germ_eq P.val.presheaf m hxW
        letI : Module Γ((U : Scheme), V) (P.val.obj (op V) : Type u) :=
          (P.val.obj (op V)).isModule
        change (P.val.obj (op V) : Type u) at s
        rw [← ha, ← hs]
        let b := (U : Scheme).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op a
        have hb : (U : Scheme).presheaf.germ V x hxV b =
            (U : Scheme).presheaf.germ W x hxW a :=
          TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ (homOfLE hVW) x hxV a
        rw [← hb]
        erw [← PresheafOfModules.germ_smul P.val x V hxV b s]
        have h1 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom (b • s))
          (germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app U.ι x F hxV)
        have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom s)
          (germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app U.ι x F hxV)
        change e ((TopCat.Presheaf.germ P.val.presheaf V x hxV).hom (b • s)) =
          (F.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) x.val (by simpa using hxV)).hom (b • s) at h1
        change e ((TopCat.Presheaf.germ P.val.presheaf V x hxV).hom s) =
          (F.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) x.val (by simpa using hxV)).hom s at h2
        change e ((TopCat.Presheaf.germ P.val.presheaf V x hxV).hom (b • s)) =
          (U.stalkIso x).hom.hom ((U : Scheme).presheaf.germ V x hxV b) •
            e ((TopCat.Presheaf.germ P.val.presheaf V x hxV).hom s)
        rw [h1, h2]
        have hb' := congrArg (fun q => q.hom b) (U.germ_stalkIso_hom x hxV)
        change (U.stalkIso x).hom.hom ((U : Scheme).presheaf.germ V x hxV b) =
          (X.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) x.val (by simpa using hxV)).hom b at hb'
        rw [hb']
        change (F.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) x.val (by simpa using hxV)).hom
            ((restrictAppIso U.ι F V).hom.hom (b • s)) = _
        rw [smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply]
        simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
        exact PresheafOfModules.germ_smul F.val x.val (U.ι ''ᵁ V)
          (by simpa using hxV) b s }
  letI : RingHomSurjective (U.stalkIso x).hom.hom :=
    ⟨(ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (U.stalkIso x).hom).2⟩
  change Module.length ((U : Scheme).presheaf.stalk x) StP =
    Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x.val) StF
  rw [Module.length, Module.length, WithBot.unbot_inj,
    Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (Submodule.orderIsoMapComapOfBijective l e.bijective)]

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
